suggested.rests_on: She is Fifth's sister and speaks of him as 28 years old in S12; she is likely close in age.
She is a painter who had a studio and is evicted in S1; she calls herself an artist in S25.
She throws paint, storms out, high-fives, dances, and fights physically across the script.

habits: Uses direct address and names people often: Jason, Des, Fifth, Jetta, Ray, Sidney.
Switches quickly between joking and serious.
Uses profanity and blunt language when angry or hurt.
Asks questions and pushes for answers.
Uses sarcasm and teasing, especially with Des and Fifth.
Speaks in short bursts when upset, longer when arguing or explaining.
voice.manner: Fast, conversational, emotionally transparent. She can be warm and funny, then sharp and confrontational. She talks over people and does not hide what she thinks.

end.state: Unconscious in the hospital after surgery, with a glass fragment still moving inside her; Desmond watches over her and tells her he needs her.

start.state: Locked out of her art space by an eviction notice and chain, desperate for Jason to answer and help her.

turns.change: After finding Jason in bed with his lover, she hesitates at the door, then chooses to open a can of paint and confront them instead of leaving.
She learns that Fifth can only be released into her custody and that Desmond expects her to sign him out, shifting her from complaining about Fifth to being responsible for him.
She begins a romance with Ray, accepting his invitation to dinner and later sleeping with him.
Ray attacks her after overhearing her tell Desmond that Ray confessed; she is stabbed and nearly killed.

relationships.development: Madison calls Jason from her locked-out art space and leaves a desperate message asking him to pick up and saying she needs him (S1). She then goes to his apartment, finds him in bed with his lover, throws paint on them, and beams the empty paint can at his head, knocking him out (S2).
relationships.name: JASON

relationships.development: Madison argues with Desmond about her borrowing money and her weight, and about Fifth's suicide attempts (S5). He accuses her of only caring when she is broke, and she defends her love for Fifth (S6). She hugs him after learning Pop was killed (S8), and later they reconnect at his apartment and a night club, where she apologizes for leaving without calling and he reveals his failed engagement (S16, S19). After Ray attacks her, Desmond arrives, hits Ray, and carries her out (S28); he later watches over her in the hospital and kisses her head (S32).
relationships.name: DESMOND

relationships.development: Jetta defends Madison as a starving artist (S5). They high five after Jetta says 'And ass to shake' (S17), and Madison asks about Jetta's tattoos (S17). Madison tells Jetta that Desmond does not mean it and calls him an incurable jackass (S18).
relationships.name: JETTA

relationships.development: Madison notices Fifth's bandaged wrists and confronts him about his suicide attempts (S12). She helps him get dressed and they walk through the city (S13, S14). She finds him at Sidney's door and hears him with Sidney (S24). Later she welcomes him and Sidney, teases him about being touchy, and says it is great to see him like this (S25).
relationships.name: FIFTH

relationships.development: Madison meets Ray at the night club and extends her hand for him to kiss (S19). They begin a romance, ending a goodbye kiss and agreeing to dinner (S22), and later lounge together feeding each other grapes (S25). She urges him to drink more wine and asks about his business (S27). After she tells Desmond that Ray confessed, Ray attacks her, stabs her, and is stopped by Desmond (S28).
relationships.name: RAY

relationships.development: Madison meets Sidney when Fifth brings her to the loft; she welcomes Sidney and invites them to join (S25). Later she thanks Sidney and jokes with her, and they slap each other five (S27).
relationships.name: SIDNEY

role.function: Her eviction and need for help set the story in motion; her custody of Fifth drives the hospital release; her romance with Ray leads to the attack that reveals Ray as Pop's killer and puts her in the hospital, motivating Desmond's actions.

story.summary: Madison is an artist who is evicted from her studio and turns to her brother Fifth and their friend Desmond. She becomes romantically involved with Ray, who turns out to be the killer of Desmond's brother Pop, and Ray stabs her when she learns the truth. She ends up unconscious in the hospital after surgery.

want.goal: To get help from Jason, then to reconnect with Desmond and find stability, and later to pursue a romance with Ray.
want.obstacle: Her eviction and lack of money, Desmond's hostility, Fifth's instability, and Ray's violence.
